heard: In the genealogy of Jacob's line The sons of Asher are named Imna, Ishva and Ishvi Beriah stands in the fame And their sister Sarah Listed with care in the text Part of the household Who came from the rest The sons of Asher by their clans From Himna, the Imnaid clan From Ishvi, the Ishvi clan From Beriah, the Braid clan From the sons of Beriah, Haber and Maltiel are found Father of Berset, He was in the land where they stood
